title: Expectation of an erased-set indicator
statement: Let $A$ be a subset of an $n$-element set and let $i$ be an element of that set. The Shapley expectation of the indicator that the subset obtained by deleting $i$ equals $A$ is the sum of the Shapley probabilities of $A$ and $A\cup\{i\}$ when $i\notin A$, and is $0$ when $i\in A$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a subset of the ground set
$i$ is an element of the ground set
